headword: クラシック{映画|えいが}

definitions.gloss: classic film; old movie; classic cinema
definitions.explanation: A film widely recognized as a masterpiece or an important work from an earlier era of cinema. Can refer to both Japanese and Western films, typically from roughly the 1920s through the 1970s.

examples.japanese: クラシック{映画|えいが}が{好|す}きだ。
{週末|しゅうまつ}にクラシック{映画|えいが}の{特集|とくしゅう}をテレビでやっている。
examples.english: They're running a classic film special on TV this weekend.

examples.japanese: {黒澤明|くろさわあきら}のクラシック{映画|えいが}は、{今|いま}でも{世界中|せかいじゅう}の{映画|えいが}ファンに{愛|あい}されている。
examples.english: Akira Kurosawa's classic films are still loved by movie fans around the world.

notes:
Composed of クラシック (classic) and {映画|えいが} (film/movie). Refers to older films that have stood the test of time and are considered masterpieces or culturally important works. The term covers both Japanese cinema ({邦画|ほうが}) and foreign films ({洋画|ようが}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クラシック{映画|えいが}の{名作|めいさく}: classic film masterpiece
- クラシック{映画|えいが}を{鑑賞|かんしょう}する: to watch/appreciate a classic film
- クラシック{映画|えいが}{特集|とくしゅう}: classic film special/feature
- クラシック{映画|えいが}ファン: classic film fan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {名画|めいが}: masterpiece film — focuses on quality rather than era
- {旧作|きゅうさく}: older work — neutral term for any older film without the "classic" quality connotation
- {往年|おうねん}の{映画|えいが}: film from years past — literary/nostalgic nuance
